text: Jean-Paul Sartre's complete works were banned by the Vatican offices that published the Index Librorum Prohibitorum as early as 1948. The Index listed books that Catholics should neither own nor read under pain of excommunication. Pope Paul VI abolished the Index Librorum Prohibitorum on 14 June 1966.
